points.quote: Students must not use generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools or AI-powered websites in ways which breach assessment instructions, for example to generate content, answers, or references.
points.gist: Students must not use AI tools or AI-powered websites in ways that breach assessment instructions, such as generating content, answers or references.

points.quote: Where the use of AI is permitted, it must be verified and appropriately referenced in the work for transparency, with details of how it was used being provided.
points.gist: Permitted AI use must be verified and referenced in the work, with details of how it was used.

points.quote: Schools will advise students of their specific rules and in assessment specifications, where appropriate.
points.gist: Schools will tell students their specific rules and set them out in assessment specifications where appropriate.

points.quote: any unacknowledged content that has been produced by another person, website, software, or Artificial intelligence (AI) tool; or
points.gist: Submitted work should not contain unacknowledged content produced by another person, website, software or an AI tool.

points.quote: If information or ideas are obtained from any source (including GenAI), those sources must be acknowledged according to the appropriate convention in that subject
points.gist: Information or ideas from any source, including GenAI, must be acknowledged following the subject's convention.

points.quote: an unacknowledged summary of a source, including a summary produced by generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI);
points.gist: An unacknowledged summary of a source, including one produced by GenAI, counts as plagiarism.

points.quote: The University reserves the right to use University-approved systems, such as similarity checking software, to assist with the detection of plagiarism or generative AI misuse in the interests of improving academic standards.
points.gist: The University may use approved systems such as similarity checking software to help detect plagiarism or generative AI misuse.
